Grid finding: infra.power_grid existed but was gated by the same node as the power station ('Central power station and grid'); split into Central power station (key 288, keeps the A9 CORE fact) and AC power transmission (transformer 1884-85, three-phase lines 1891), which now gates the grid entity and the grid-scale generation types (hydro, wind, storage, smart grid; D11 offered it as the precise grid edge of nuclear power-plant engineering). Bottlenecks split along their own content, workload roughly conserved: internal_combustion (134k) -> Stationary gas engine (Lenoir/Otto, the principle; feeds diesel) + High-speed petrol engine (key kept: Age fact and every vehicle consumer; now requires petroleum refining), -22.6 %; computer (535k) -> Programmable digital computer (relay OR valve routes, D05's request) + Stored-program computer (key kept; memory from radar), conserved; transistor (268k) -> Semiconductor physics + device, -20.3 %. steam_rotary is kept: no faithful split. Missing knowledge: Water turbine (dams drive turbines, not water wheels). Causal fixes: Newcomen engine no longer needs cast-iron cannon (early cylinders were brass); charcoal needs felling axes, not house framing; lithium-ion needs quantum theory of solids (shortest chain was 12 nodes); gas turbines need superalloys (D02); smartphone needs digital cellular data (D05). Coupling: both windmills move to the trunk (craft knowledge, D-044 R15). D04's thermodynamics (diesel, steam_turbine), D04's probability_statistics (machine_learning) and D05's automatic_switching (programmable_computer) are wired at integration (integrationRequests, override format). Dead ends get deferred owners (M8/M9/M10+) or explicit justification. Energy capabilities are knowledge-only or deferred to M11+ (milestone M10+). Everything is PROPOSED.

Liquid fuel is now explicit: Daimler's and Benz's engines ran on light petroleum spirit (ligroin, bought at a pharmacy on Bertha Benz's 1888 drive - RESEARCHED).
